sites.name: Banteay Chhmar archaeological complex
sites.what: Khmer archaeological complex and temple in Banteay Meanchey. Cambodia submitted the complex to UNESCO’s tentative list in 2020.

access.closures: Not yet checked. Smartraveller advises do not travel within 50 km of the Cambodia–Thailand border in Banteay Meanchey province; check current advice and the site’s position before travel.
